owner_note.text:
worktree-preview landed after deciding 1 thing for you:
- Every landed, unmerged worktree is held (folder kept), but only one whose task asked for a preview goes on the LAN and is exempt from stop_idle and the reaper (a loopback server is restarted by the proxy on a visit, so keeping every waiting server up costs memory for nothing; onl); alternatives: exempt every waiting worktree from stop_idle / preview-only exemption
